observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same setup: a white PlayStation 5 Slim console, a black and white DualSense controller, and a stack of five blue game cases.
The console has a visible crack or chip on the top left corner of the front panel.
The controller is placed in front of the console, with the DualSense logo visible.
The game cases are stacked, with the top case showing 'FC26' and a PEGI 3 rating.
The background is a wooden surface, and the items are placed on a white surface with a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DEKINGS MUSICAL'.
No power cord, HDMI cable, or other accessories are visible in the photos.
The console appears to be in used condition, with some minor scuffs and wear.
